source: Hansen et al. (2013) Global Forest Change v1.12 (2000-2024), UMD/Google, CC BY 4.0
method: Hansen ~30 m pixels inside the cell and inside CanopyProof's baseline forest mask. A Hansen pixel counts as loss if its loss year is 2019-2024; a CanopyProof pixel counts if its loss was confirmed (two consecutive disturbed looks) between 2019-01-01 and 2024-12-31.
